root_causes.title: Missing Infigraph runtime and capability contract
root_causes.description: The codebase currently lacks an integration wrapper for the Infigraph CLI. There is no code path for capability checks, reproducible metadata resolution, or standardized status handling for the analysis.
root_causes.solution_summary: Introduce a new module `scripts/analysis/infigraph.py` providing `InfigraphRuntime` with methods to check capabilities and run analysis, returning normalized statuses. Add corresponding tests using a fake executable.

tasks.title: Add reproducible Infigraph runtime and capability contract
